This violates CLAUDE.md rule 7 (all user-facing copy goes through messages/en.json). A suitable key already exists from this same milestone — `booking.suspended` ("Your account is paused. Please contact support to continue.") is used by the parallel guard in app/(customer)/actions.ts:26 via t(). The sibling createBooking guard does it correctly; only this new session-start guard hardcodes the copy. (The other hardcoded strings in this file on lines 47 and 85 are pre-existing, not introduced by this diff.)
Suggestion:Import is already there for t-style usage in the customer actions; reuse the existing key, e.g. `return { error: t("booking.suspended") };` (add the t import to this file as done in app/(customer)/actions.ts).
